policy: 2026.10.08.6 is the reviewed learner UI reference for the intentional app-wide Mission Control redesign approved for merge. The reference preserves the persistent Mission Control context bar, mission timeline, evidence drawer, command/search layer, adaptive learner/technician/engineer modes, Spatial Twin integration, and the mobile-safe idle shell while retaining the established Learn, Book, Materials, Practice, assessment and diagnostics surfaces underneath. The captured runtime is the exact 5d5ce2fa6a1d827bd935e38d4a70e06be6f7edad render after fixing learner-scoped mission rehydration, modeless evidence-region semantics, mobile overlap/containment, and exact command-search targeting. Pixel tolerance remains locked at maxDiffPixels 12; this promotion changes the retained reference bytes rather than relaxing the visual gate. Physical-device, real-AT, SME, learner-outcome, NZQA/provider, Windows-distribution and production evidence remain separate HOLDs.
